name: miru
description: Hybrid semantic and keyword code search for coding agents.
long_description: Miru (見る) indexes a local repository and gives agents `search`, `locate`, `expand`, and `find_related` tools. Requires Bun (https://bun.sh) on PATH; the bundle launches the published npm package with bunx.

takara_api_key.title: Takara API key
takara_api_key.description: Optional. Without it, the MCP auth tool signs in with a device code.

default_repo.title: Default repository
default_repo.description: Optional. Repository searched when a tool call omits `repo`.
